caption: The host asks its resolver once, recursively; the resolver then makes three iterative contacts — root, com, example.com — each one query and one reply, so 6 messages. The answer is cached for TTL 300 s: a repeat at 200 s costs 0 messages, and at 300 s the record has expired so the walk costs 6 again.

spec.aria: Sequence diagram: the host sends one recursive query to its resolver; the resolver makes three iterative query-reply exchanges with the root, com and example.com name servers, then returns the A record with TTL 300 s to the host.
